```plato
//==
// # IImage interfaces
//
// The single abstraction shared by every raster type: a rectangular grid with
// known dimensions. Pixel access is deliberately absent, because pixel
// representations differ (bytes, floats, indices, bits); the concrete image
// types in `images.types.plato` each expose their own. Unless a type says otherwise,
// pixel storage is row-major starting at the top-left pixel, and a pixel
// array's Count equals Width times Height.

// A raster image: a rectangular pixel grid with known dimensions. Pixel access
// is deliberately not part of the interface; each concrete image type exposes its
// own pixel representation. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Raster_graphics)
interface IImage
    inherits IValue
{
    Size(x: Self): IntegerSize2D;
}
```
